en.headline: Man dies after suspected snorkelling accident off Sai Kung’s Hang Hau Chau
en.dek: A 58-year-old man was pulled unconscious from the sea near Hang Hau Chau on Friday afternoon and later certified dead at Tseung Kwan O Hospital; he had been out with colleagues on a private boat trip.
body: A 58-year-old man died on Friday after a suspected snorkelling accident off Hang Hau Chau in Sai Kung. Police received a report at about 2.31 pm that a man was floating in the water roughly 10 metres from the shore. A passing white speedboat recovered him in an unconscious state.

Marine police took the man to the Sai Kung marine base before an ambulance transferred him to Tseung Kwan O Hospital. He required cardiopulmonary resuscitation on the way and was certified dead at 3.57 pm. A woman carrying snorkelling gear accompanied him to hospital.

According to the man’s elder brother, the deceased had worked at Hong Kong Disneyland since its opening in 2005, operating parade floats. He had experience with snorkelling and joined a spontaneous outing organised by colleagues, not by the park. The group had anchored near the island; several people entered the water, but conditions later grew rough with waves of more than a metre. Others returned to the boat and only then realised he was missing.
Police are investigating the circumstances. A post-mortem examination will be arranged to determine the exact cause of death.

zh.headline: 西貢吊鐘洲男子浮潛疑遇溺不治
zh.dek: 一名58歲男子周五下午在西貢吊鐘洲對開海面被發現昏迷，送院後不治；他與同事出海遊船河期間落水浮潛。
body: 一名58歲男子周五在西貢吊鐘洲對開約10米海面懷疑遇溺身亡。警方下午約2時31分接報，指有人在該處海面漂浮，一艘途經白色快艇將昏迷的男子救起。
水警將事主送往西貢水警基地，其後由救護車轉送將軍澳醫院。事主送院途中需進行心外壓，延至下午3時57分證實不治。一名手持浮潛裝備的女子陪同送院。
死者胞兄表示，死者自2005年香港迪士尼樂園開園起一直在樂園工作，負責操控巡遊車玩偶。他有浮潛經驗，是次與同事自發出海，並非樂園安排。船隻停泊在島嶼附近，數人落水後風浪轉大，浪高逾一米，其他人返回船上才發現他不見蹤影。
警方正調查事件經過，稍後會安排驗屍確定死因。
